item.title: Lightweight Docker engine in WSL without Docker Desktop
item.description: Docker Desktop provides many features, but it also is heavy and takes a lot of time to start. This made me remove it and install only Docker Engine directly in WSL and reduced the startup time from minutes to seconds. In this post I’ll show how to do it and some configurations to better the experience.
